_evidence: 0x0040f112 reads car-record bytes through esi: +0x70 (movzx, dec, js exit when 0; row = (b-1)*22 into the lap x position table 0x007c3260, which 0x522c66 clears as 0x882 = 99 rows of 22 bytes, so b is 0..99), +0x415 (shr 1 = race position; 0x408f42 stores 2*i, i 0..21, so 0..43 keeps the cell in its row), +0x7c (and 0x3f) and +0x8d bit 1 (the value written). Any value of the last two is valid.
